run_memory_setup: run the interactive memory provider setup wizard to discover and configure a memory plugin
run_memory_setup_provider: run memory setup for a specific provider by name, skipping the interactive picker
run_memory_status: display the current memory provider configuration and plugin availability status
run_memory_command: route memory subcommands like setup or status through the argparse router
test_memory_provider_discovery: test the memory provider discovery function that auto-detects installed plugins
